name: How do I choose the best bathtub material for my bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the best bathtub material for my bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Acrylic and fiberglass are the most common lightweight options, offering warm surface temperatures and straightforward installation, though acrylic is more durable and scratch-resistant than basic fiberglass. Enameled steel and cast iron offer exceptional durability and a classic feel, but cast iron is extremely heavy and may require subfloor reinforcement before installation. Stone resin and composite freestanding tubs provide modern, high-end aesthetics but require ample floor clearance and dedicated floor-mounted or wall-mounted filler valves. Your choice depends on aesthetic preference, structural support, and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose acrylic for low maintenance and durability, cast iron for superior heat retention and classic appeal, or composite stone for high-end freestanding styles.
